claims.natural_statement: All five listed artifacts, ten claim versions for eight old identifiers, twelve evidence records and seven routes have explicit indexed dispositions and five substantive reports/verdicts, with no duplicate counting; final native independent acceptance remains pending.

The strongest old result is source-bound C_ENGINE@3: the exact abstract scheduled-recursion bound under fixed legal block policy, Lipschitz profile, valid index-zero root with defined potential, nonnegative overheads and local max-plus hypotheses. Actual analytic instantiation remains conditional and no Falconer theorem is established.

The existing read-only exact checker reproduces twenty profile/parameter instances, 29624 suffix/high row checks including zero costs, 437 direct checks, 485 inherited memberships, seven positive direct checks and six positive inherited memberships, without universal or geometric inference.

Both historical general-LP requests were rejected by normalization admission and give no mathematical result. A separate bounded rational-system check verifies only the existing three-row coefficient identity, not a repaired LP, policy premise or new theorem.

C_ANALYTIC@1 and A_ANALYTIC_REDUCTIONS remain unestablished by the old combinatorial draft: actual supported Fourier reductions, uniformity, numerical branching, overheads, stopping/error bounds and a finite max-plus envelope are concrete gaps, not refuted assertions.

C_ASSEMBLY@1 and the global scope of C9000073@1 remain unestablished by the old draft. Entry cancellation, original-mass restoration and monotone scalar reconstruction are coherent conditional subarguments, not a proof or refutation of the compact-set Falconer conclusion.
